title: Path Length
description: Validates file paths for length and format compatibility across platforms. Long paths can cause issues on some operating systems and storage systems.

102.title: Deep Nesting
102.description: Warning when a file path has more than 8 nested folder levels. Very deep folder structures can cause compatibility issues on some systems.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the depth count (number of directory segments)

103.title: Path Too Long
103.description: Error when a file's full path exceeds platform limits (typically 255 characters). Shorten folder and file names to ensure compatibility.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path length in characters

104.title: Mixed Case Path
104.description: Recommendation to use only lowercase letters in file and folder names. Mixed case can cause issues on case-sensitive file systems.
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path with mixed case characters
